approach.method_basis: The Parent evolves molecular graphs from the current session’s accepted molecules. It draws breeding parents from high-scoring population quantiles, applies connected-fragment crossover or short sequences of atom, bond and ring edits, and admits a fresh pool of 160 canonical, unseen molecules through its inherited sulfur rule. A Gaussian process fitted to all accepted scores uses count Morgan fingerprints and generalized Tanimoto similarity. For each of ten purchase positions it draws a correlated posterior score function over the pool and chooses the highest available value, excluding earlier winners. After three consecutive batches without an incumbent improvement, only the forty candidates with the highest original predictive means are eligible; the first improving batch restores the full pool. Accepted outcomes update the archive and the population of sixty-four survivors. The Parent already removed a dormant rejection-conditioned edit floor; that floor is absent here too.
approach.novelty: This experiment removes sampled-residual influence only while the existing top-forty restriction is active. Those positions buy the highest remaining original predictive mean, using the original pool order to break ties. Every original correlated draw is still computed, and unrestricted purchases continue to use it. This isolates whether residual-driven alternatives remain useful after the stall screen has concentrated the field. It differs from siblings that removed correlation or mean location within the screen, and from earlier mean-only controls applied throughout a run. The immediate prediction is a move toward higher original mean; the conservative utility prediction is that losing residual-guided alternatives lowers total useful progress. A complete exposed nondecrease would contradict that utility prediction.

observed_bottleneck: The actual code Parent n-cf8d309c06de reaches diverse de novo fields but cannot consistently convert posterior-directed purchases into larger incumbent gains. Its complete Search mean is 0.607030316211131 (seed standard deviation 0.030175277546149237), and residual presence within its stalled top-forty restriction is still unidentified. An independent read-only reconstruction of all fifteen Parent logs and trajectories reproduced the frozen policy replay exactly: 88 restricted announcements, 794/880 different sequential positions, 88/88 different purchase sets, 712 same-available disagreements, and 402 original paid identities outside the mean-only sets (302 late). The complete original paid stream contains 4,350 purchases and gain mass 5.978073077532332; 2,175 late purchases contain gain mass 1.0224077547621127. Evidence is recorded in policy/scratch/r0060-02-improve-L01/evidence-audit.json and its fifteen audit-seed-N-task.json files, which cite and hash each underlying nodes/n-cf8d309c06de/seed-N/logs/task.log and trajectories/task.jsonl file. The Parent summaries and run.log files establish successful complete execution. The whole-run mean-only loss on the mask-free sulfur-gated host n-f04cec6ab705 (-0.11631688) and wider stalled residual n-189cd716f027 (-0.00971828) are different conditions. On this exact Parent, n-5e03d3ccd1b7 removed restricted correlation while retaining residual presence and lost 0.00835268; n-8e00e5e9fc34 removed restricted mean location while retaining residuals and lost 0.02309243. The qPO screen/correlation controls n-0e978ade2613 and n-61819156f98f also lost on a different allocator, so they do not supply this missing component contrast. These observations justify the frozen state-scoped presence control, not a residual-amplitude sweep or a claim that deterministic means will improve endpoints.

literature_review.conclusion: Reuse search-policy-r60-state-and-count-consumers as required by the frozen ticket. Posterior sampling explains the retained original consumer, while campaign evidence motivates removing it only inside the already implemented restriction. Preserve original posterior calculations and draw consumption, measure active choice exposure and actual paid consequences, and test positive conditional utility conservatively. No new literature adoption, model, package, amplitude adjustment or additional arm is needed.
literature_review.internal_evidence_reason: This is the frozen internal existing-consumer control, supported by exact-Parent source inspection, complete Search summaries/logs, the source-pinned actual-state replay and specific nearby contribution tests. The cited Search Policy review recorded the listed searches and primary sources; queries are inherited provenance, not claimed fresh searches. No paper construction is introduced and no posterior-sampling guarantee transfers to these adaptively generated molecular pools.

sources.applicability: Context for the existing sampled-function maximizer only. hypothesis: Remove the active consumer of the sampled residual only at successful FingerprintPosterior.select allocations with restrict_top_mean is not None. At each such position select argmax_i original_mean[i] among the current inherited eligibility mask minus earlier active winners, with earliest pool-index ties. At restrict_top_mean is None select the original argmax_i sampled_values[position,i]. The original count-GP mean, covariance, Cholesky and jitter, score scale, normal array and correlated sample arithmetic remain computed in their original order, and the original finite guard must succeed before either rule selects. The gate reads the actual preannouncement session state and releases after the original strict-improvement reset. This changes residual presence as a decision consumer, not residual construction, covariance, amplitude, mean location or the stall rule.

finding_summary.headline: Restricted mean-only choices activate exactly but lose 0.01862, supporting the retained residual’s conditional value
finding_summary.insights: Higher original predicted means and more local parent wins did not produce more endpoint progress. This narrows the issue to which useful alternatives are purchased during stalled search, while preserving the original posterior and random draws; it does not show that covariance, the top-mean gate or every residual decision is independently beneficial. The two largest losses occur on sitagliptin, where the Molecular audit also finds more concentrated late analogues: fragment-excluded within-session similarity rises from 0.429290 to 0.466156 and typed/generic scaffold counts fall from 274/101 to 211/84. Those adaptive chemistry changes describe the weakened search path rather than prove mediation. Across the panel, predicted-stream error actually decreases while endpoints decline, so average purchased-stream predictive fit is insufficient to diagnose progress. Ring-rich families still include reactive heteroatom halogens, strained closures and no specified stereochemistry; this control leaves those generation limitations intact. A proposal operator that preserves useful local chemical context, or an acquisition/search scheme that deliberately sustains useful alternatives beyond current mean ranking, addresses that kind of limitation; neither capability was tested here. Two zero-exposure cells are retained, passive-only molecules have no measured rewards, and the final 150 purchases are censored for later breeding. The result leaves broader residual regimes and structural methods open, and cannot be added to a sibling intervention.
finding_summary.results: The mechanism executed in all 86 restricted announcements. Every restricted purchase set changed, replacing 382 of 860 actual purchases relative to the passive original-rule sets and increasing the original model’s summed predictive mean by 14.42284. All 349 unrestricted announcements preserved their sampled choice rule at the same Child states, and there were no execution failures or missing purchase joins. Across all fifteen task/seed cells, the final mean fell from 0.607030 to 0.588409 (−0.018621); all three seed-average differences were negative, with four task/seed gains, seven losses and four ties. Full incumbent-gain mass fell from 5.978073 to 5.698752, and late gain from 1.022408 to 0.864164, even though more purchases beat their generating parents (634 to 663). The restricted residual therefore has positive conditional contribution on this host at the registered descriptive scale; the removal itself worked as intended.

molecular.headline: Ring-rich aromatic analogues retain reactive heteroatom halogens, strained closures and undefined stereochemistry despite moderate scaffold variety.
molecular.overall_character:
This assessment describes actual output from n-2d61abf0b2bd against its code Parent n-cf8d309c06de. The frozen comparison declares Child complete and Parent pairing complete: all five tasks under frozen Search seeds 0/1/2, all 15 Child and 15 published Parent trajectories, with no missing task or input file. Each side has 4,500 accepted records: 150 initial records and 4,350 optimizer purchases. Every task/seed contributes 290 purchases and 145 late purchases. Late means optimizer ordinals 146–290 (evaluations 156–300), retaining the final five purchases of the crossing announcement. All 4,350 purchases on each side parse in RDKit 2023.09.6; summaries report no invalid, duplicate or budget-full proposals. These statements concern paid proposals, not every unpurchased pool member or attempted graph edit. No held-out or Confirmation evidence was accessed.

Child median/mean/range heavy atoms are 28/28.2579310/1–96, versus Parent 28/28.5018391/1–96. Child counts below 6, below 12, above 50 heavy atoms are 91, 124, 43 of 4,350; Parent counts are 91, 124, 44. The below-6 set is nested in below-12, not additive. Late counts are 33/42/3 of 2,175 Child versus 33/45/3 Parent; late mean sizes are 28.0358621 versus 28.2937931. Both tails stay visible; neither the handful of bare atoms nor the largest molecules defines the central distribution.

There is ample ring and aromatic chemistry: 4,255/4,350 Child molecules have rings and 4,229 have aromatic atoms. The supplied string ring rates range 0.9713–0.9851 and aromatic rates 0.9609–0.977, consistent with that reading. RDKit gives 1,653 nonempty typed Bemis–Murcko scaffolds and 1,016 generic carbon/single-bond skeletons in the Child, versus 1,667/951 in the Parent. Empty scaffolds are explicitly retained as 95 molecules on each side and excluded from those distinct counts. Late distinct counts are 760/461 versus 774/414, with 35 versus 36 empty scaffolds. These are unions over paid records, not counts of independently explored chemical families. Within-session analogues remain locally similar despite many distinct atom/bond scaffold strings.

Fingerprint similarity uses RDKit Morgan 2048-bit vectors, radius 2, includeChirality=True, and bit Tanimoto, not the optimizer's count kernel. Pairs are unordered and within the same task/seed; there are no cross-session pairs. Full Child/Parent within-session means are 0.298884/0.296088 over 628,575 pairs per side; within-announcement means are 0.412229/0.411038 over 19,575 pairs per side. Requiring both molecules to have at least 12 heavy atoms gives session means 0.313962/0.311054 on 593,257/593,265 pairs, and batch means 0.433037/0.431990 on 18,490/18,484 pairs. Late session means are 0.390992/0.385005 on 156,600 pairs per side, and batch means 0.432848/0.427419 on 9,600 pairs per side. Late fragment-excluded means are 0.404652/0.399417 on 150,627/150,198 session pairs and 0.447960/0.442925 on 9,236/9,219 batch pairs. Thus local similarity remains after tiny fragments are excluded; these are descriptive adaptive histories, not independent samples.

For output localization only, all Child purchases join to their actual offspring observations and logged purchase membership, with zero unjoined purchases and zero logged posterior-fallback announcements. Actual-only membership means an actually purchased identity absent from the passive original-rule set at that same Child pool; restricted-shared and unrestricted-shared identities occur in both sets. These groups contain 382/478/3,490 purchases full and 305/395/1,475 late, summing to the complete denominators. All actual-only and restricted-shared molecules have 22–35 heavy atoms, zero below-6/below-12/above-50 counts, and all have rings and aromatic atoms. All full and late size-tail purchases occur in the unrestricted-shared group. This group inherits changed feedback and is not an untreated control. Actual-only full typed/generic scaffolds number 141/85 and late 110/70; restricted-shared 149/84 and 116/66; unrestricted-shared 1,551/979 and 659/423. Group scaffold sets overlap and are not additive.

Actual-only full/late within-session similarity is 0.450393/0.487079 on 7,187/4,838 pairs; within-batch 0.493076/0.510054 on 820/625. Restricted-shared full/late session similarity is 0.484649/0.506386 on 14,859/10,408 pairs; batch 0.506625/0.509728 on 1,252/1,050. Fragment exclusion leaves both groups unchanged because every member exceeds the size cutoff. Unrestricted-shared full/late session similarity is 0.273088/0.348122 on 420,105/83,150 pairs; batch 0.391072/0.397532 on 15,705/6,500. Requiring both members at least 12 changes these to 0.289396/0.363053 on 392,107/79,272 session pairs and 0.415818/0.418184 on 14,620/6,136 batch pairs. Within-group pair counts exclude cross-group pairs and cannot sum to overall pair counts. Empty groups retain n=0 and null similarity, never a fabricated zero mean. Every cell, including the two zero-restricted-exposure cells and late zero-unrestricted-exposure cell, is retained in the per-cell audits. Same-available and sequential-position differences are stored separately from membership. No score is assigned to passive-only molecules. Future-use summaries are right-censored for the final 150 purchases (38 actual-only, 42 restricted-shared, 70 unrestricted-shared); earlier lack of reuse also describes a finite observation window.

The main missing quality is chemically conservative realization of otherwise recognizable aromatic, carbonyl and amine arrangements. Child/Parent N–halogen motif counts are 765/888, O–halogen 378/162, N=O 263/242, single N–N 420/231, O–O 130/118, and molecules with any RDKit ring of at most four atoms 1,282/1,172, each over 4,350. These SMARTS categories overlap; N=O is a pattern count, not proof that every match is a nitroso group, and a small ring alone is not proof of instability. The high-score examples specifically show N-halogen hydrazines, O–F substituents, nitroso groups and unusual fused/bridged ring closures. Some ordinary ether, amide, imide, aromatic and amine fragments look familiar, but graph validity does not establish an isolable compound or a synthetic route. No stereocentre is explicitly specified in any paid SMILES; RDKit finds potential unassigned centres in 2,725/4,350 Child molecules versus 2,578 Parent. Two Child strings contain charge-separated nitrogen notation, so the output is not entirely devoid of charged atoms; net charge and protonation behavior must not be conflated.

All conclusions here are structural readings and associations with the existing scores. No binding pose, measured stability, solubility, synthetic route, protonation distribution, therapeutic utility, counterfactual outcome or mechanism activation is established. Parent history was read from the frozen evidence-index published path and authoritative Parent trajectories; prior abbreviated chemistry claims were not used as proof of generator impossibility. Complete per-cell source paths and hashes are in audit-seed-N-task.json files cited below; panel-audit.json stores all full/late/group metrics and input-manifest.json pins the original frozen staging paths to byte-identical run-relative copies. The top 87 include 68 N–halogen, 52 single-N–N and 59 small-ring molecules, versus 14/13/10 in the bottom 87. This does not prove those liabilities are individually rewarded; several correlated edits and histories differ.

method_name: Mol GA: rank-selected de novo graph evolution
method_thesis: Anchor the root in Mol GA: maintain a population of oracle-evaluated molecular graphs, sample breeding parents across high-ranked quantiles, generate new offspring through graph crossover and atom/bond mutations, and update survivors greedily after each observation. These are the proposal and selection mechanisms described by [Tripp and Hernández-Lobato (2023)](https://arxiv.org/html/2310.09267v1). Start from the supplied initial observations and incorporate newly evaluated offspring immediately, following the evaluator's announced batching. Repeated graph edits and recombination create an evolving search space; no corpus ranking, stored molecule library, pretrained model, or fixed candidate enumeration is needed. The causal hypothesis is that direct selection on task-local scores concentrates successive structural changes around improving molecules quickly enough to raise the final best observed score. The published evidence concerns a larger-budget AUC-Top-10 setting, so its transfer to this benchmark's final Top-1 objective remains a hypothesis.
